id.description: Flagsmith Project ID (0 indicates unlinked placeholder)

key.description: Unique identifier of the feature flag (e.g. checkout_v2, maintenance_mode)

description.description: Human-readable description explaining the purpose of this flag

type.description: Flag type: STANDARD (simple toggle/remote config) or MULTIVARIATE (A/B experiment)

default_enabled.description: Default baseline state across all environments before overrides

value.description: Default remote configuration value; for MULTIVARIATE flags this is the control/baseline value
Challenger value served to clients; must differ from the control value

percentage.description: Percentage of traffic allocated to this challenger (0-100); the control receives the remainder

items.description: Challenger arm for a multivariate experiment

variants.description: Challenger variants for MULTIVARIATE flags; percentages must total 100% or less and the control receives the remainder

name.description: Unique name of the experiment metric event (e.g. signup_completed)

description.description: Description of the business outcome measured

aggregation.description: How Flagsmith computes the metric (occurrence, count, sum, mean)

direction.description: Expected direction of improvement (up: higher is better, down: lower is better, informational)

enabled.description: Whether the flag is enabled in this environment

value.description: Environment-specific value override; inherits the flag value when omitted

items.description: Flag state override for one named environment

environments.description: Environment-specific overrides, one entry per environment (e.g. [{ name: Production, enabled: true }])

archived.description: Whether this feature flag is archived

flags.description: List of declared feature flags, remote configurations, and multivariate experiments

description: Declarative Flagsmith feature flag and experiment manifest (flagsmith.yaml)
title: Flagsmith YAML Manifest
